Lucidchart Diagramming Tool Lucidchart has been chosen for its easy-
to-use interface, and its suit of 
diagramming tools, which is essential for 
architectural visualisation, planning, and 
explaining complex processes to the 
reader (Lucidchart, n.d.). 
Figma UI/UX Design Tool Figma offers an easy-to-use UI design 
package, which is critical for planning, 
creating and visualising user interfaces 
before they are eventually developed 
(Figma, n.d.). With large companies 
offering their components for copy and 
paste usage, the prototype designs 
become align well with the developed 
application. 
Monday Time Management 
and Project 
Planning Tool 
Monday.com has been chosen for its fast 
user interface, enabling the developer to 
rapidly create Gantt Charts with 
interconnecting dependencies, time spans 
and priorities. 
JMeter Load Testing Tool JMeter is an open-source tool designed to 
perform load testing and make 
measurements on software . It can 
simulate heavy loads on networks to test 
a products strength and resilience 
(Apache, n.d.).
